failing: a: revenue rose in only 1 of 4 transitions
b: EPS fell >10% in 3 of 4 transitions
c: EPS positive in only 4 of 5 years

buffett_price.growth_method: R14 smoothed growth (fewer than 10 years of owner earnings)
